dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, thick white fringes on the greater and median coverts create distinct horizontal tiers of light bands against dark feather centers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Very prominent and sharp pale edges are visible along the folded primary and secondary feathers, creating clear linear boundaries against the dark brown feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp and distinct transition is visible where the uniform grayish-brown texture of the crown/nape meets the high-contrast scalloped pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: The bird exhibits a highly repetitive and uniform scalloped pattern across the entire dorsal surface, characterized by broad white U-shaped fringes.
